exterior_reference_applicability: PASS for representative ordinary pre-facelift E46/4 four-door exterior: actual RU ordinary-front/shell positive evidence is established. Frozen requirement does not constrain steering orientation. Preserve real UK/RHD steering/wipers and disclose source market; do not claim Russian-original LHD or regulatory certification. Scalar10mm disagreement remains separate and does not establish a different visible bumper/body. This is reference applicability, not generated-image acceptance or production-ready declaration.

actual_observations: Actual original shows two door handles and front/rear door splits on visible side, fixed B pillar, rear quarter glass, separate rear boot: four-door E46 Sedan, not coupe/Compact/Touring.
Pre-facelift lamps have twin internal round reflectors and scalloped lower outline, separate amber outer corners; rounded paired kidney grille integrated in bonnet.
Ordinary bumper has full-width black impact strip, small rectangular horizontal fog lamps and low horizontal intake. No M-aero bumper/splitter/large round-fog conversion.

Exact frozen Auto.ru Sedan image and independent Russia Drom pre-family photo show the same phase lamp/bonnet/ordinary bumper architecture. Source wheel design differs from catalogue examples but no evidence links this wheel choice to a different shell or 10mm longer bumper.
Roof and mirrors are wholly visible in actual original; no resolved mast, fin or rails. Do not add a default roof accessory.

Source cabin visible steering wheel is on the vehicle right, consistent with UK caption/registration. Exact live primary specifies left-hand steering; this difference is recorded rather than treated as proven RU-original equipment.

market_boundary.source_real_details: Keep actual UK/RHD steering wheel/dashboard/wipers and other source facts. Do not silently convert them to LHD, mirror the vehicle, conceal source market or certify headlamp aiming/regulatory compliance.
